```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10, dpi = 150)
```

# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.3.1_pathway_module_enrichment_join", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output:", dir_output, "\n")
```

# 3. Load data

```{r helpers}
find_latest_dated_dir <- function(base) {
  dirs  <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  dated <- sort(dirs[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(dirs))],
                decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(dated) == 0) stop("No dated subdirectory under: ", base)
  cat("Using:", dated[1], "\n")
  dated[1]
}
```

## 3a. Enrichment results from 04_GO_KEGG

All `*_tissue_cluster_all.csv` files under all subdirectories of the latest dated dir.

```{r load_enrichment}
dir_gokegg <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04_GO_KEGG"))

enrich_files <- list.files(dir_gokegg, pattern = "_tissue_cluster_all\\.csv$",
                           full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Found tissue_cluster_all CSV files:\n")
for (f in enrich_files) cat(" ", basename(dirname(f)), "/", basename(f), "\n")

enrichment_all <- bind_rows(lapply(enrich_files, function(f) {
  db_label <- basename(dirname(f))   # subdirectory name: GO, KEGG, MSigDB, Reactome
  read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(db_dir    = db_label,
           tissue    = as.character(tissue),
           miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster))
}))

cat("\nTotal enrichment rows loaded:", nrow(enrichment_all), "\n")
cat("Databases (db_dir):\n")
print(table(enrichment_all$db_dir))
cat("Tissues:\n")
print(table(enrichment_all$tissue))
```

## 3b. Pathway modules from 04.3

```{r load_modules}
dir_net <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.3_pathway_network"))

modules_df <- read.csv(file.path(dir_net, "pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(tissue = as.character(tissue),
         module = as.character(module))

cat("Pathway modules rows:", nrow(modules_df), "\n")
cat("Tissues:\n")
print(table(modules_df$tissue))
cat("Sources:\n")
print(table(modules_df$source))
```

# 4. Parse node_id → pathway_id

`node_id` format is `{source}|{pathway_ID}`. Extract the part after `|` as join key.

```{r parse_node_id}
modules_df <- modules_df %>%
  mutate(pathway_id = sub("^[^|]+\\|", "", node_id))

cat("Example node_id → pathway_id mapping:\n")
modules_df %>%
  distinct(source, node_id, pathway_id) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# 5. Join

Left join: `modules_df` (base) ← `enrichment_all` on `pathway_id == ID` + `tissue == tissue`.
Each module row retains all enrichment metadata where available.

```{r join}
joined_df <- modules_df %>%
  left_join(
    enrichment_all %>%
      dplyr::select(ID, tissue, miRNA_cluster, GeneRatio, BgRatio,
                    pvalue, enrich_p_adj = p.adjust, qvalue, geneID, Count, db_dir,
                    any_of("msigdb_set")),
    by = c("pathway_id" = "ID", "tissue" = "tissue")
  )

cat("=== Join result ===\n")
cat("Rows in modules_df  :", nrow(modules_df), "\n")
cat("Rows after join     :", nrow(joined_df), "\n")
cat("Matched (non-NA miRNA_cluster):", sum(!is.na(joined_df$miRNA_cluster)), "\n")
cat("Unmatched           :", sum(is.na(joined_df$miRNA_cluster)), "\n")
```

# 6. Diagnostics

## 6a. Match rate per source

```{r diag_source}
joined_df %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total   = n(),
    n_matched = sum(!is.na(miRNA_cluster)),
    pct_match = round(n_matched / n_total * 100, 1),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_total)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## 6b. Match rate per tissue

```{r diag_tissue}
joined_df %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total   = n(),
    n_matched = sum(!is.na(miRNA_cluster)),
    pct_match = round(n_matched / n_total * 100, 1),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tissue) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## 6c. Unmatched module pathways (top 30)

```{r diag_unmatched}
cat("=== Unmatched pathways (module pathway not found in enrichment CSVs) ===\n")
joined_df %>%
  filter(is.na(miRNA_cluster)) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, source, node_id, Description, module) %>%
  arrange(source, tissue) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## 6d. Module × miRNA cluster coverage

```{r diag_module_cluster}
cat("=== module_id × miRNA_cluster pairs ===\n")

module_id_col <- if ("module_id" %in% names(joined_df)) "module_id" else "module"

joined_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(miRNA_cluster)) %>%
  mutate(module_id_label = paste(tissue, "mod", .data[[module_id_col]], sep = "_")) %>%
  count(tissue, module_id_label, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = miRNA_cluster, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L,
              names_prefix = "cluster_") %>%
  arrange(tissue, module_id_label) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# 7. Export

```{r export}
write.csv(joined_df,
          file.path(dir_output, "pathway_module_enrichment_joined.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: pathway_module_enrichment_joined.csv\n")

# Summary: one row per tissue × module × miRNA_cluster
summary_df <- joined_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(miRNA_cluster)) %>%
  group_by(tissue, module, source, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pathways   = n(),
    top_pathway  = Description[which.min(enrich_p_adj)],
    min_p_adjust = min(enrich_p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tissue, module, source, miRNA_cluster)

write.csv(summary_df,
          file.path(dir_output, "pathway_module_cluster_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: pathway_module_cluster_summary.csv\n")

cat("\n=== Summary table ===\n")
print(summary_df, n = Inf)

# Excel: tissue-wise sheets for joined_df
wb <- createWorkbook()
for (tis in sort(unique(joined_df$tissue))) {
  addWorksheet(wb, tis)
  writeData(wb, tis, joined_df %>% filter(tissue == tis))
}
saveWorkbook(wb,
             file.path(dir_output, "pathway_module_enrichment_by_tissue.xlsx"),
             overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Saved: pathway_module_enrichment_by_tissue.xlsx\n")
```
